name: Roaring Brook Nature Center Summer Discovery Days
description_short: Weekly themed nature programs at Roaring Brook Nature Center in Canton, in four age groups from Acorns (ages 4 to 5) to Oaks (grades 4 and up). Each week brings hikes, games, stories, crafts and visits with the center's animals. Summer 2027 dates and themes will be posted in early 2027.

sources.note: Roaring Brook's own Summer Discovery Days page; shows the 2026 programs, 2027 not yet posted
Operator's 2026 page: $270 members, $315 non-members per program, Mon-Fri 9am to noon

source.title: Summer 2026 Discovery Days – The Children's Museum

warnings: This page covers Summer 2026, which is already over (today is 2026-10-13). Dates and prices for 2027 aren't posted here yet.
The page lists no individual program weeks, dates or grade ranges. It says the full list is on the RBNC website.

Prices are per program. The page doesn't say outright that a program is one week long; this is inferred from 'Each week offers themed activities' and the Monday–Friday schedule, so price_per_week uses the non-member rate as an estimate.

The page belongs to the parent organization (The Children's Museum), not Roaring Brook Nature Center's own site. The only address given (8 Wilcox Street, Suite E, Simsbury, CT 06070) is the administrative office, not the camp location.
